pillar_1_tenure_structure.advisor_recommended: 15-year baseline contractual tenure with an effective target closure of 12.1 to 13.5 years via overdraft interest savings[cite: 2].
pillar_1_tenure_structure.framework_suggested: Dual-Phase tenure structure (25-year contractual tenure with a 10-year effective target)[cite: 2].
pillar_1_tenure_structure.difference: The advisor locked in a short 15-year contractual tenure, whereas the framework prescribes a maximum 25-year contractual tenure to lower mandatory monthly obligations for High LTI cash-flow preservation while aggressively targeting a 10-year payoff[cite: 2].

pillar_2_product_architecture.advisor_recommended: Overdraft / Home Saver facility (via Bank of India, PNB, ICICI, or Axis)[cite: 2].
pillar_2_product_architecture.difference: Advisor recommended an Overdraft product carrying potential interest rate premiums (0.25%–0.50%) and operational complexity, whereas the framework recommends a standard $0 Fee Floating loan[cite: 2].

pillar_3_risk_mitigation.advisor_recommended: Maintain an emergency liquidity corpus of ₹18–20 lakhs (6 months EMI + 6 months expenses) in the OD account; avoid bundled single-premium life insurance; complete loan disbursement prior to final payslip during an employer transition[cite: 2].
pillar_3_risk_mitigation.framework_suggested: Build and preserve a liquidity buffer to absorb structured prepayments safely[cite: 2].
pillar_3_risk_mitigation.difference: Advisor focused on specific operational risk mitigations (job change timing, insurance unbundling, and keeping ₹18–20 lakhs in OD), whereas the framework emphasizes buffer allocation specifically for annual prepayment execution[cite: 2].

pillar_4_repayment_guidelines.advisor_recommended: Park liquid funds, emergency corpus, and monthly rental yield (₹55,000) directly into the overdraft account to continuously offset principal interest daily[cite: 2].
pillar_4_repayment_guidelines.difference: Advisor recommended ongoing daily cash parking in an OD account, whereas the framework calls for structured periodic lump-sum prepayments (1 Extra EMI per year + 50% bonus sweep)[cite: 2].

service_delivery_comparison.advisor_actual_delivery: Empathetic, consultative tone sharing personal professional experiences; utilized an OD screen-share spreadsheet/calculator to demonstrate interest savings and offered advice on property legal due diligence[cite: 2].
service_delivery_comparison.framework_suggested_delivery: Guided Shepherd overlay requiring an educational, highly empathetic tone accompanied by a Fee Line-Item Audit Sheet & Stress-Test Scenarios[cite: 2].
service_delivery_comparison.difference: Advisor maintained an empathetic and educational tone, but failed to provide the required Guided Shepherd visual artifacts (Fee Line-Item Audit Sheet and Stress-Test Scenarios)[cite: 2].

Pillar 2 & 4 Deviation: Recommended an Overdraft product with continuous cash parking rather than a $0 Fee Floating loan with structured annual prepayments (1 Extra EMI/yr + 50% Bonus Sweep)[cite: 2].
